principle: Difficulty measures reasoning complexity, not terminology complexity. A record whose only hard part is an unfamiliar word is EASY.
mappingNote: The repository Question Bank carries a separate 6-level authoring difficulty (1 Foundation .. 6 Master). These five bands are the archive's model and are NOT that scale. repositoryLevelHint is an advisory mapping for a future ingestion contract only; nothing consumes it today and it implies no entitlement tier.

bands.description: One principal task, minimal ambiguity, low dependency count, basic recognition or application, one main trap.
Two to three logical steps over interacting facts, exactly one missing or conflicting element, and a prioritisation call.
Three to five dependencies, competing priorities, a contradiction or a scope boundary, evidence discipline, and a downstream consequence.
Five or more dependencies, incomplete information under time pressure, competing objectives with safety/privacy/coding implications, and several plausible paths of which one is defensible.
A multi-stage encounter with delayed clues, evolving evidence, several roles, ownership transitions, branching consequences, replay and audit reconstruction.
bands.accessNote: Charter section XXXIII: Realistic Premium is a distinct access class. Presence in the corpus grants no entitlement.
